name: manage_script
description: Register, unregister or list user scripts as tools. register takes a script path anywhere on disk, copies it into the scripts directory and makes it a tool from the next round; description, parameters, timeout and group come from the script header (# Description:, # Parameters:, # Timeout:, # Group:) unless overridden here. unregister hides a script or deletes its file.

action.description: register adds or updates, keeping fields you leave out; list shows registered, unregistered and disabled scripts with their directories.

id.description: Tool name. Required for unregister; on register it defaults to the header id, else the file name with non-alphanumerics folded to _.

path.description: register: absolute path anywhere on disk, or a file name already inside the scripts directory. Omit to update an existing entry.

scope.description: register: where a copied script lands. persona (default) is visible only to the current persona.

display_name.description: Human-readable name, Chinese allowed. Defaults to the header line.

description.description: Header override. Required only when the header has none.

parameters.description: JSON Schema override. With neither, the tool takes free-form arguments passed as JSON on stdin.

overwrite.description: register: replace a same-named file already in the scripts directory.

delete_file.description: unregister: delete the file too. Built-in scripts can only be hidden.
